problem_title: Positivity conjecture for trigonometric polynomials from square-root coefficients

evidence.text:
We refute Kovalev Conjecture 1.3 using d=49, partial-sum index 949 and t=arccos(523/527). A finite integer certificate proves strict negativity of the literal trigonometric sum from the normalized square-root Taylor coefficients. The coefficient recurrence, cosine bridge and source counterexample are proved in Lean.
